label: IGH / CCND1

sections.text: IGH is the immunoglobulin heavy-chain locus involved in B-cell antigen-receptor diversity.

audit_evidence.scope: Normal partner description only; not primary fusion evidence.

sections.text: CCND1 encodes cyclin D1, a regulator of CDK4/6-dependent cell-cycle progression.

audit_evidence.location: NCBI Gene 595 RefSeq/Alliance summary, inspected cached esummary record
audit_evidence.scope: Normal partner description only; not primary fusion evidence.

sections.text: IGH/CCND1 rearrangements are documented in mantle cell lymphoma and plasma cell myeloma. A sequenced mantle cell lymphoma case had a cryptic insertion of intact CCND1 into IGH; optical genome mapping also identified IGH/CCND1 events in myeloma.

audit_evidence.location: Figure1A-I and Figure2C-D, patient pathology and mate-pair-sequencing junction/insertion plots
audit_evidence.scope: CCND1-positive MCL with an intact CCND1 insertion into IGH; routine FISH-negative cryptic event. Primary figure captions inspected at PMID31015206.

audit_evidence.location: Primary results paragraphs describing IGH rearrangements; Figure1c,e; publisher lines301,312
audit_evidence.scope: IGH rearrangements with CCND1(28),FGFR3/NSD2(12),MAF(4),MAFB(2); exact structural/disease observations, not functional expression tests.

report_comment.text: IGH is the immunoglobulin heavy-chain locus involved in B-cell antigen-receptor diversity. CCND1 encodes cyclin D1, a regulator of CDK4/6-dependent cell-cycle progression. IGH/CCND1 rearrangements are documented in mantle cell lymphoma and plasma cell myeloma. A sequenced mantle cell lymphoma case had a cryptic insertion of intact CCND1 into IGH; optical genome mapping also identified IGH/CCND1 events in myeloma.
